products.name: HDFC Millennia
products.tagline: 5% back on 10 popular apps, 1% on the rest

benefits.title: 5% CashPoints on partner shopping apps
benefits.channel: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Tata CLiQ, BookMyShow, Cult.fit, SonyLIV, Uber
benefits.conditions: 5% as CashPoints; 1 CashPoint = Rs 1 statement credit (min 500 CP to redeem). 5% tier capped at 1,000 CashPoints per statement cycle, shared across all 10 merchants.

benefits.title: 5% CashPoints on Swiggy and Zomato
benefits.conditions: Part of the 10-merchant 5% tier; 1 CashPoint = Rs 1 statement credit. Shared cap of 1,000 CashPoints per statement cycle.

benefits.title: 1% CashPoints on other spends
benefits.conditions: 1 CashPoint = Rs 1 statement credit. Capped at 1,000 CashPoints per statement cycle (separate from the 5% cap). Fuel, rent, wallet loads, EMI and government spends excluded.

benefits.title: No rewards on fuel
benefits.conditions: Excluded from rewards

benefits.title: No rewards on rent
benefits.conditions: Excluded from rewards

benefits.title: 3.5% forex markup
benefits.conditions: Plus GST

benefits.title: Quarterly lounge access or voucher
benefits.conditions: Quarterly benefit (domestic lounge access or a voucher, either/or) requires Rs 1 lakh spend in the previous quarter. Sources disagree on visit counts.

products.name: Swiggy HDFC Bank
products.tagline: 10% back on Swiggy, 5% on online spends

benefits.title: 10% cashback on Swiggy
benefits.conditions: Covers Swiggy food, Instamart and Dineout. Cashback credited to statement. Capped at Rs 1,500 per statement cycle. From April 2026 each Swiggy transaction must be Rs 249 or more.

benefits.title: 5% cashback on online spends
benefits.conditions: Eligible online merchant categories only. Separate cap of Rs 1,500 per statement cycle.

benefits.title: 1% cashback on other spends
benefits.conditions: Capped at Rs 500 per statement cycle.

benefits.title: 3.5% forex markup
benefits.conditions: Plus GST

benefits.title: 5% NeuCoins on Tata Neu and Tata brands
benefits.conditions: 5% NeuCoins on non-EMI spends at Tata Neu and partner Tata brands; 1 NeuCoin = Rs 1 on Tata Neu (usable only in Tata ecosystem). An extra 5% is possible via NeuPass on the Tata Neu app, but not on Tata Pay bills, Tanishq, Cult.fit, Air India or Tata Play.

benefits.title: 1.5% NeuCoins on other spends
benefits.conditions: 1.5% NeuCoins on non-Tata spends and merchant EMI; 1 NeuCoin = Rs 1 on Tata Neu. UPI earns a lower rate (sources conflict: 0.5% to 1.5% depending on UPI ID, cap 500 NeuCoins/month).

benefits.title: 2% forex markup
benefits.conditions: Plus GST

benefits.title: 2% NeuCoins on Tata Neu and Tata brands
benefits.conditions: 2% NeuCoins on non-EMI Tata spends; 1 NeuCoin = Rs 1 on Tata Neu (Tata ecosystem only). Extra NeuPass coins possible via Tata Neu app.

benefits.title: 1% NeuCoins on other spends
benefits.conditions: 1% NeuCoins on non-Tata spends and merchant EMI; 1 NeuCoin = Rs 1 on Tata Neu. UPI spends earn 1% capped at 500 NeuCoins per calendar month.

benefits.title: 3.5% forex markup
benefits.conditions: Plus GST

benefits.title: 5 reward points per Rs 150
benefits.conditions: 5 RP per Rs 150; 1 RP = about Rs 0.30 on cashback/catalogue redemption (worth Rs 1 on SmartBuy travel or airmiles, i.e. ~3.3%).

benefits.title: 10X points on SmartBuy flights and hotels
benefits.conditions: 10X points (50 RP per Rs 150) on SmartBuy flights/hotels; valued at 1 RP = Rs 0.30 cashback (33% at Rs 1/RP for travel redemption). Overall SmartBuy cap 15,000 RP/month (= Rs 4,500 at Rs 0.30); vouchers capped at 3,000 RP/month from July 2026.

benefits.title: 2% forex markup
benefits.conditions: Plus GST

benefits.title: Unlimited domestic and international lounges
benefits.conditions: Unlimited airport lounge access for primary and add-on cardholders.

products.name: HDFC Diners Club Black Metal Edition
products.tagline: Premium Diners metal card with quarterly milestones

benefits.title: 5 reward points per Rs 150
benefits.conditions: 5 RP per Rs 150; 1 RP = about Rs 0.30 on cashback/catalogue redemption (Rs 1 on SmartBuy travel/airmiles, ~3.3%).

benefits.title: 2% forex markup
benefits.conditions: Plus GST; confirmed only on an aggregator

benefits.title: 10,000 bonus points per Rs 4 lakh quarter
benefits.conditions: 10,000 bonus reward points on spends of Rs 4 lakh in each calendar quarter.

products.name: HDFC Regalia Gold
products.tagline: Travel card with lounges and milestone vouchers

benefits.title: 2% forex markup
benefits.conditions: Plus GST

benefits.title: 12 domestic + 6 international lounge visits
benefits.conditions: 12 domestic and 6 international lounge visits a year. Domestic access is spend-gated from July 2026 (sources disagree on the quarterly threshold: Rs 35,000 or Rs 60,000).

benefits.title: Quarterly and annual milestone vouchers
benefits.conditions: Rs 1,500 voucher on Rs 1.5 lakh spend per calendar quarter; Rs 5,000 flight voucher at Rs 5 lakh annual spend and another Rs 5,000 at Rs 7.5 lakh.

benefits.title: 5 RP per Rs 200; 5X on Myntra, Nykaa, M&S, Reliance Digital
benefits.conditions: Since 15 May 2026: 5 RP per Rs 200 on retail, 5X on partner brands (cap 7,500 RP/month). The statement-credit value per point was not confirmed, so no percentage rate is given.

products.name: HDFC MoneyBack+
products.tagline: 10X CashPoints on Amazon, Flipkart, Swiggy and more

benefits.title: 10X CashPoints on partner brands
benefits.channel: Amazon, Flipkart, Swiggy, BigBasket, Reliance Smart
benefits.conditions: 10X CashPoints; 1 CP = Rs 0.25 statement credit. Rate shown is after the May 2026 change to per-Rs 200 accrual (2.5%); older sources say 3.33%. Cap 2,500 CP per calendar month (= Rs 625).

benefits.title: Base CashPoints on other spends
benefits.conditions: 1 CP = Rs 0.25 statement credit; 0.25% after the May 2026 revision (older sources: 0.33%).

benefits.title: 3.5% forex markup
benefits.conditions: Plus GST

products.name: IndianOil HDFC Bank
products.tagline: Fuel Points at IndianOil, groceries and bills

benefits.title: 5% Fuel Points at IndianOil
benefits.conditions: 5% as Fuel Points; 1 FP = Rs 0.96 when redeemed for free fuel at IndianOil via XTRAREWARDS (catalogue/cashback only up to Rs 0.20, i.e. ~1%). Cap 250 FP/month for the first 6 months, then 150 FP/month (= Rs 144).

benefits.title: 5% Fuel Points on groceries
benefits.conditions: 5% as Fuel Points (POS and e-commerce); 1 FP = Rs 0.96 as IndianOil fuel. Cap 100 FP per month (= Rs 96).

benefits.title: 5% Fuel Points on bill payments
benefits.conditions: 5% as Fuel Points; 1 FP = Rs 0.96 as IndianOil fuel. Cap 100 FP per month (= Rs 96).

benefits.title: 1% fuel surcharge waiver
benefits.conditions: 1% fuel surcharge waived on transactions of Rs 400 and above (one review says capped at Rs 250/month).

products.name: Marriott Bonvoy HDFC Bank
products.tagline: Marriott points, free night and Silver Elite

benefits.title: 3.5% forex markup
benefits.conditions: Plus GST (one aggregator says 2%)

benefits.title: 8/4/2 Marriott Bonvoy points per Rs 150
benefits.conditions: 8 Bonvoy points per Rs 150 at Marriott hotels, 4 on travel/dining/entertainment, 2 on other retail. Fuel, rent, wallet, EMI and government payments excluded. Points have no fixed rupee value, so no percentage rate is given.

benefits.title: Lounges, free night and Silver Elite
benefits.conditions: 12 domestic and 12 international lounge visits a year; Free Night Award on joining and renewal; Marriott Bonvoy Silver Elite status. No fee-waiver spend.
